chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from سماعة, who said:
I asked him about a man who fabricates an accusation against another man, then pardons him, then wants to have him flogged after the pardon. He said: “He has no right to that after the pardon.”

key_terms.اَلْعَفْوِ: pardon or remission of the claim
key_terms.لَيْسَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ: he has no entitlement or legal right to that
key_terms.يَجْلِدَهُ: to have him flogged as a legal punishment
key_terms.يَعْفُو: to pardon or forgo one's claim

ai.seo_question: Can someone demand punishment for false accusation after already granting pardon?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding false accusation and pardon. It states that once the offended party has pardoned the offender, he no longer has the right afterward to demand the hadd punishment.
